items.q: What if I don't have new photos or videos?
items.a: We cover the gap with AI posters, so your page stays active even in weeks when you have no new material.

items.q: How do I send you my photos and videos?
items.a: Share them on WhatsApp or email, along with any offer or price details you want in the video.

items.q: How fast will I get my videos?
items.a: Starter videos are delivered within 24 hours. Growth is same-day delivery, and Pro gets priority same-day delivery.

items.q: Which platforms do you post to?
items.a: Starter covers Instagram and Facebook. Growth adds YouTube Shorts. Pro covers Instagram, Facebook and YouTube Shorts, with Telegram on request.
